summary: Constructed a bounded three-way mechanism contrast after #974: active AND with two input-state slots, the identical active AND with one pair-valued slot, and an idle background lookup. All three match at neutral settings. Reused Hume's existing Changes predicate: with the other input held true, an ideal override changes the first two targets but not the idle target; the active models coincide for every public override. The packing bijection and a simple four-pair capacity test reveal why one graph slot can hide two degrees of freedom while one Boolean bit cannot. RootParity is reused from #974. These are explicit model definitions and proofs subject to hosted Lean/comparator verification; neither causal efficacy in reality nor ultimate metaphysical unity is supplied. Follow-up COUNTERPOSSIBLE-CONSERVATIVITY retains the no-latent-source-intervention boundary and interprets only PUBLIC contributor a off in explicitly separate repair contexts, comparing conservative conditional evaluations; see docs/notes/counterpossible-conservativity.md. It does not establish source-nonexistence or actual counterpossible truth.
blocker: Philosophical bridge OPEN: show, using independently motivated evidence and admissible interventions or another defensible notion of production, why one-source ontic unity rather than two independently packaged state bits would explain a joint effect.
